bhphoto.text:
The @nikonusa Z5IIC, a new compact full-frame mirrorless camera with a responsive touchscreen and easy-to-use controls, has hit the market and is making waves. Aimed to provide a more natural, expressive way of shooting, the kit boasts a variety of features including:

☑️ NIKKOR Z 24-50mm f/4-6.3 lens
☑️ 24.5 megapixel BSI-CMOS FX-format sensor
☑️ Large, vari-angle touch LCD
☑️ Autofocus in near-total darkness with AF detection down to -10EV
☑️ 7.5 stops of built-in image stabilization
☑️ 4K/60p video capture and 12-bit N-RAW recording

After a day on set with the Z5IIC, our biggest highlights are its image quality, intuitive handling, and lightweight design. Would this be a camera you add to your lineup?
